# Logging Errors and Warnings

Messages reported by PostSharp.Patterns.Diagnostics, the logging library.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:dia002?text=DIA002> | Error | A logging aspect is applied to an abstract method, which has no body to log. |
| <xref:dia003?text=DIA003> | Warning | A logging profile sets an execution time threshold, but its exception level is lower than its default level. |
| <xref:dia004?text=DIA004> | Error | A logging aspect names a logging profile that is not defined. |
| <xref:dia005?text=DIA005> | Warning | The project is built with PostSharp Logging in developer mode, so its logging stops 24 hours after the build. |
